bio: We love this trendy contemporary bistro as much for its charming hospitality as for its tasty, up-to-the-minute cooking, such as a thick loin of cod, fregola sarda and poultry jus. The concise menu-carte, which ensures the freshness and quality of seasonal ingredients, is a steal at lunchtime! Don't miss the excellent cannelé, a nod to the couple's Bordeaux roots. There is a fine selection of wines on the blackboard....
